title: Liveness / recovery (tmux): missing and same-name replacement, ambiguous dialog and foreign foreground, bounded nudge, restart once, completed builder restarted as its PR's fix pass, unsafe teardown keeps the tree

steps.name: up-spawn-four
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; G={state_dir}/gh; $C up $P && for i in 2 3 4 5; do $C spawn builder --issue $i $P --timeout 10 || exit 1; done; $C status $P | grep -cE "^builder-[2-5] .* alive" | grep -qx 4

steps.name: exited-harness-is-missing
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; G={state_dir}/gh; tmux send-keys -t "=$T:builder-2" "campaign-exec: exit 0" Enter; for i in $(seq 50); do $C status $P | grep -qE "^builder-2 .* missing" && exit 0; sleep 0.1; done; exit 1

steps.name: same-name-replacement-is-missing
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; G={state_dir}/gh; i=$(tmux list-windows -t $T -F "#{window_index} #{window_name}" | sed -n "s/ builder-3$//p"); tmux kill-window -t "=$T:builder-3" && tmux new-window -d -t "$T:$i" -n builder-3 "sleep 600" && $C status $P | tee /dev/stderr | grep -qE "^builder-3 .* missing"

steps.name: dialog-is-ambiguous-send-types-nothing
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; G={state_dir}/gh; tmux send-keys -t "=$T:builder-4" "campaign-exec: printf 'Do you want to proceed?\\n 1. Yes\\n Esc to cancel\\n'" Enter; for i in $(seq 50); do $C status $P | grep -qE "^builder-4 .* ambiguous" && break; sleep 0.1; done; $C status $P | grep -qE "^builder-4 .* ambiguous" || exit 1; $C send builder-4 fix "#4" $P; rc=$?; test $rc -eq 4 && ! grep -q "^got builder-4: inbox" {state_dir}/stub.log

steps.name: foreign-foreground-is-ambiguous
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; G={state_dir}/gh; tmux send-keys -t "=$T:builder-5" "campaign-exec: exec sleep 600" Enter; for i in $(seq 50); do $C status $P | grep -qE "^builder-5 .* ambiguous" && exit 0; sleep 0.1; done; exit 1

steps.name: ambiguous-never-restarts
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; G={state_dir}/gh; for w in builder-4 builder-5; do $C restart $w $P | grep -q "refusing restart: $w is ambiguous" || exit 1; done; $C status $P | grep -cE "^builder-[45] .* ambiguous" | grep -qx 2

steps.name: bounded-nudge-no-ack
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; G={state_dir}/gh; out=$($C send builder-3 fix "#3" $P) || exit 1; id=$(echo "$out" | sed -n "s/crew: sent \([^ ]*\) .*/\1/p"); $C acked builder-3 "$id" --wait 2 $P; test $? -eq 3

steps.name: missing-restarts-once
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; G={state_dir}/gh; $C restart builder-2 $P --timeout 10 && $C status $P | grep -qE "^builder-2 .* alive" && tmux send-keys -t "=$T:builder-2" "campaign-exec: exit 0" Enter && sleep 1 && $C restart builder-2 $P | grep -q "already restarted once"

steps.name: done-builder-restarts-as-fix-in-same-worktree
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; G={state_dir}/gh; wt() { python3 -c "import json,sys;print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))['worktree'])" $S/runs/$1.json; }; w=$(wt builder-3); git -C "$w" -c user.name=c -c user.email=c@x commit -q --allow-empty -m wip && h=$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD) && echo "done: #3 #7 $h" >> $S/status/builder-3.status && n0=$(ls {worktree_root} | wc -l) && $C restart builder-3 $P --timeout 10 | tee /dev/stderr | grep -q "in its worktree $w" && test "$(ls {worktree_root} | wc -l)" -eq "$n0" && test "$(wt builder-3)" = "$w" && python3 -c "import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert (r['pass'], r['args']['pr'], r['item']) == ('fix', 7, 'issue #3, PR #7'), r" $S/runs/builder-3.json && grep -q "Restarted after done: as Pass fix" $S/runs/builder-3.brief.md && $C spawn builder --issue 3 $P --timeout 10; test $? -eq 1

steps.name: unsafe-teardown-keeps-tree
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; G={state_dir}/gh; wt() { python3 -c "import json,sys;print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))['worktree'])" $S/runs/$1.json; }; w=$(wt builder-3); CREW_POOL=builder $C kill builder-3 $P; test $? -eq 1 && test -d "$w" && git -C "$w" log -1 --format=%s | grep -qx wip && test -f $S/runs/builder-3.json
